CinC 2025

# Loading packages
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(caret)
library(MLeval)
library(knitr)

# Loading PCAS results 
## Healthy Data
healthy_errors <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features/errors.csv')
healthy_latents <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features/temporal_representations.csv')
## Incident MI
iMI_errors <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features_MI/errors.csv')
iMI_latents <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features_MI/temporal_representations.csv')
## Prevalent MI 
pMI_errors <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features_prevalent/errors.csv')
pMI_latents <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/results/ssa_pca_50_components_on_pca_12_components_separated_features_prevalent/temporal_representations.csv')

# Loading PCA benchmark results
healthy_ED <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/healthy_ED_latents.csv')
healthy_ES <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/healthy_ES_latents.csv')
iMI_ED <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/incident_MI_ED_latents.csv')
iMI_ES <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/incident_MI_ES_latents.csv')
pMI_ED <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/prevalent_MI_ED_latents.csv')
pMI_ES <- read.csv('/home/wolf6273/singular_spectrum_analysis/prevalent_MI_ES_latents.csv')
# Creating a combined error df 
## Formatting the error frames
healthy_errors %>% 
  mutate(data = 'healthy') %>% 
  dplyr::select(-model) -> healthy_errors 

iMI_errors %>% 
  mutate(data = 'iMI') %>% 
  dplyr::select(-model) -> iMI_errors

pMI_errors %>% 
  mutate(data = 'pMI') %>% 
  dplyr::select(-model) -> pMI_errors

## Combining into a single error frame
errors <- rbind(healthy_errors,
                iMI_errors,
                pMI_errors)
# Combined latent dataset
healthy_latents %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:(last_col()-1), names_to = 'latent_var') %>% 
  mutate(latent_var = as.numeric(str_extract(latent_var, '\\d+')),
         data = 'healthy') -> healthy_latents
iMI_latents %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:(last_col()-1), names_to = 'latent_var') %>% 
  mutate(latent_var = as.numeric(str_extract(latent_var, '\\d+')),
         data = 'iMI') -> iMI_latents
pMI_latents %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:(last_col()-1), names_to = 'latent_var') %>% 
  mutate(latent_var = as.numeric(str_extract(latent_var, '\\d+')),
         data = 'pMI') -> pMI_latents

latents <- rbind(healthy_latents,
                 iMI_latents,
                 pMI_latents)

Methods

Dataset

# Combined PCA latnet dataset
colnames(healthy_ED) <- str_replace(colnames(healthy_ED), 'X', 'ED_')
colnames(healthy_ES) <- str_replace(colnames(healthy_ES), 'X', 'ES_')
healthy_pca <- cbind(healthy_ED, healthy_ES)
healthy_pca %>% mutate(data = 'healthy') -> healthy_pca

colnames(iMI_ED) <- str_replace(colnames(iMI_ED), 'X', 'ED_')
colnames(iMI_ES) <- str_replace(colnames(iMI_ES), 'X', 'ES_')
iMI_pca <- cbind(iMI_ED, iMI_ES)
iMI_pca %>% mutate(data = 'iMI') -> iMI_pca 

colnames(pMI_ED) <- str_replace(colnames(pMI_ED), 'X', 'ED_')
colnames(pMI_ES) <- str_replace(colnames(pMI_ES), 'X', 'ES_')
pMI_pca <- cbind(pMI_ED, pMI_ES)
pMI_pca %>% mutate(data = 'pMI') -> pMI_pca 

pca_latents <- rbind(
  healthy_pca,
  iMI_pca,
  pMI_pca
)
pca_latents %>% 
  relocate(data, .before = 1) -> pca_latents
pca_latents

Results

We fit the model described in Section \[INSERT REF\] on a training set of healthy individuals, and test the model on a healthy, incident MI and prevalent MI cohort (healthy/iMI/pMI test.)

Reconstruction

Table [INSERT REFERENCE] shows the mean and standard deviation of the average Chamfer distance over all frames for each subject. We see that although there is a decrease in the reconstruction quality for the iMI and pMI groups, it is not significant, and still below the voxel dimensions of the original images.

# Summary table for the number of samples
errors %>% 
  group_by(data, error_type) %>% 
  distinct(sample) %>% 
  summarise(n_samples = n())
`summarise()` has grouped output by 'data'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.
